{{Quote|Jabba sends a lackey to do an assassin's job!''"<br />"''Wrong. He sent the best bounty hunter of his house.|[[Jhordvar]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="BF:ANT" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''duel''' took place in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] between the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Jhordvar]].

==The duel==
{{Quote|You know, Jhordvar, you should've surrendered when you had the chance. But you fought bravely, I'll give you that.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], after [[Jhordvar]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]]|<ref name="BF:ANT" />}}
When [[Jhordvar]] tried to betray [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], who was tracked to his hideout in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] by the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Fett offered Jhordvar the chance to accompany him back to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], but the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] refused to surrender. After a brief but intense fight, Fett killed Jhordvar.<ref name="BF:ANT" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I did as you commanded, Lord Jabba. I gave the assassin Jhordvar the choice of returning with me, or accepting his own death. He chose the latter. Unfortunately for him. But not, O Mighty Jabba, for you.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]|<ref name="BF:ANT" />}}
Following the duel, a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] stranded Fett for several [[Standard year/Legends|days]] in the Noghri's lair, with the alien's body exposed to the sand and heat. The sandstorm [[Mummy/Legends|mummified]] what remained of Jhordvar and snapped off his [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="BF:ANT" />

Fett took only the hands to identify Jhordvar and left the rest of the body in the desert. Upon Fett's return at Jabba's Palace, [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] identified Jhordvar by a [[Color/Legends|gold-green]] [[amaralite]] [[Ring/Legends|ring]] on one of the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] hands, and Fett received his bounty.<ref name="BF:ANT" />
